name: Rise Again
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level cleric/oracle 7, shaman 7, white necromancer 7

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser rise again except it can revive a creature who was killed by a death effect and prevents them from instantaneously becoming an undead if applicable.
